subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “In class, he said the diary made the war feel less like a chapter title and more like…”?
options: A diary may not explain everything, but it can make the past harder to ignore.
Once measured, it becomes harder to ignore and easier to reduce.
Before using data to make decisions, people must check how the data was collected.
A city that ignores toilets may look modern while making daily life harder for many people.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「In class, he said the diary made the war feel less like a chapter title and more like human life under pressure.…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Once measured, it becomes harder to ignore and easier to reduce.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Before using data to make decisions, people must check how the data was collected.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A city that ignores toilets may look modern while making daily life harder for many people.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「In class, he said the diary made the war feel less like a chapter title and more like human life under pressure. A diary…」，答案為「A diary may not explain everything, but it can make the past harder to ignore.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A diary may not explain everything, but it can make the past harder to ignore.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
